svg.text: Four pieces per aircraft. Wings stay spread in this edition. Blue lines on M1 locate the fuselage and fin feet; do not fold M1.
Solid: cut | Blue dashed: fold | Lilac: glue foot | Score before cutting.
Print single-sided at 100% / Actual size. No Fit to page. Use 160-200 gsm card.
Simplified display miniatures. Trial-build one before making the fleet. Guide: /aircraft
